description: Sets how you work on one of the person's claimed sites: automatic, where you deploy each change as you go, or approve, where you propose each change with mttr_propose and deploy it only once the person approves. Turning approve off is emailed to the person. mttr_proposals({ site }) says which a site is set to.

mode.description: approve to ask the person before each change, automatic to deploy as you go.

site.description: The site, as a domain such as example.com.

name: mttr_approvals_set
title: Set how changes are approved
